moments.action: A held take at a blue temple table: M fills in a small paper slip beside Amah, who sits turned away from him. By the end of the take the pen is down and he is holding the finished slip.
M walks past the shelves of gold Buddhas and amulet baskets, eyes down. Cut to an insert of the pink wall he reaches: rows of handwritten coffin-donation receipts pinned up.
At the counter, shot/reverse-shot: Amah bends over it in her glasses while M talks at her side. Across the exchange he stops talking and his face drops, ending looking down at her in silence.
M bows his head over the counter in close foreground; the take opens out to a wide of the sunlit temple yard as Amah walks away on her cane, following a man past the horse statues.
